narration.reasoning:
The transaction is executed on the Safe (c0, c1) after verifying two owner signatures via ecrecover (c2, c3). The Safe increments its nonce from 1 to 2 (s3) and delegatecalls into MultiSendCallOnly v1.4.1 (c4) to batch two operations:
1. A call to USDC to transfer 2,500,000,000 base units (2,500 USDC) from the Safe to Dana (c5, c6), which updates their respective USDC balances (s0, s1, b0, b1) and emits a Transfer event (e1).
2. A call to USDC to approve Ravi to spend 10,000,000,000 base units (10,000 USDC) on behalf of the Safe (c7, c8), which updates the USDC allowance slot (s2) and emits an Approval event (e2).
Finally, ExecutionSuccess is emitted by the Safe (e0).

effects.sentence: Safe approves Ravi to spend up to 10,000 USDC on its behalf.
Safe increments its nonce from 1 to 2 and records successful execution of the MultiSendCallOnly v1.4.1 batch.
